svg.aria-label: simulated: Context efficiency from scripted replays. No model runs. This is the source of the 43.7 % figure (simulated, 2026-10-11). agent-glm / agent-deepseek / agent-opus: A real model, the same task in three arms: without the server, with it, and with it plus the instruction to use it first. Task sets L1-L6 (sample project and this repo) and I1-I6 (generated 683-file fixture). agent-claude: Pre-registered external harness (Claude Code sessions). Read-only
